question: What is recited while holding the purifier in the palms?
premises: this is recited to the lord
it addresses acts done from desire or unwillingness
inference: Holding the purifier in the palms, one recites this address to the lord about acts done from desire or unwillingness.
plain_english: Taking the purifier in the palms, recite this to the lord: whatever was done by me from desire or unwillingness.
